text:
Time, I hate you. Though without you I would not exist.

And by your passing I will die though by your passing I was born.

Like Saint Francis Borgia I now want

to love someone whom time does not touch

and for us to rent a room where night does not pass

nor the neon signs go out one by one.

translation.title: Time, I Hate You. Though Without You I Would Not Exist
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the paradox of hating time while owing birth to it, ending in a room outside night.
